def _pin(result):

    flat = [float(v) for pair in pairs for v in pair] + [float(v) + 1000.0 for v in unpaired]
    return (sum(math.sin(0.31 * (i + 1)) * v for i, v in enumerate(flat))

            + 10000.0 * len(pairs) + len(unpaired))
